title: Direct flue gas capture for algae cultivation and subsequent valorization: evaluating life cycle emissions and costs
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00329F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Udayan Singh, Farah Naaz, Troy R. Hawkins, Ed Weinberg, Sudhanya Banerjee, Robert Mroz, Nidhi Ohri, Jingyi Zhang, Yi-Ying Lee, Feng Chen, Russell Hill, Yantao Li
The article presents the greenhouse gas and cost implications of algae production in a photobioreactor using flue gas directly, and its subsequent valorization. Process sensitivities and design considerations are also discussed to guide future work.
